headline: The Hartford To Acquire Equitable’s Employee Benefits Business
summary: HARTFORD, Conn., August 04, 2026--The Hartford has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Equitable’s1 Employee Benefits business, which focuses on providing small and midsize employers with flexible, non-medical benefits. The acquisition, which accelerates The Hartford’s Employee Benefits growth strategy, represents approximately $500 million in premium, and is expected to close in the fourth quarter, subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.
